settings.text: No. The Sleepsteady Mattress Protector is made of an ultra-soft TENCEL™ top layer and a polyurethane moisture barrier bottom layer which is completely silent as you sleep.

settings.text: Does the protector change the feeling of my mattress?

settings.text: No! Our protector is made up of high quality, ultra luxurious Tencel fabric. We've been told by customers that it actually improved the feeling of their mattress.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Will the protector make me hot at night?
settings.text: Will the protector make me hot at night?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · No! Our ultra soft TENCEL™ top layer has
settings.text: No! Our ultra soft TENCEL™ top layer has unique cooling properties built-in. The patented fibres wick moisture away from your body as you sleep, helping you stay cool and dry all night long.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · How do I clean the protector?
settings.text: How do I clean the protector?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It's easy! If you notice and spills or l
settings.text: It's easy! If you notice and spills or liquids on the mattress you can just wipe them off with a cloth or paper towel. When you are ready to give it a wash, just make sure to wash on warm water and dry on medium heat.

settings.text: We offer free shipping on orders over $100. Order under $100 are charged a flat-rate of $15 for shipping. Don't like the protector? We offer free returns for up to 90 days.
